description: NaCH₅O₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaCH₅O₄ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.57 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one H and two O atoms. The C-H bond length is 1.11 Å. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom.
